page.notes: Italic type is approximated from the scan, especially at the boundaries of italic and roman passages in the first paragraph. "los" at the top is a line fragment that I could not identify; it stays a fragment. "luforia" is uncertain (perhaps "ludoria") and is copied as printed. The three Greek words in the last line are uncertain and have been copied as best I can read them. The catchword "quaren-" is at the right foot.
